# Now surface: map

**Owns:** Now, the home the user opens first: Needs you (the shell's `NeedsYouFeed`), Running, Since you left and today's tokens, nothing else. All of it comes from the one `now` query, which `now.changed` replaces whole. The Project filter narrows the three feeds, each with its "in other Projects" note; desks and tokens stay Office-wide. It reads the service through `src/api/` (see [the web app's map](../../MAP.md)).
